identity.title: List of alternately colored Pokémon in animation

leadText: This is a list of alternately colored Pokémon in various Pokémon animated media. This page also includes Shiny Pokémon as well as other Pokémon with unique appearances and features.
plainText:
This is a list of alternately colored Pokémon in various Pokémon animated media. This page also includes Shiny Pokémon as well as other Pokémon with unique appearances and features.

== ==
Pokémon with a different color scheme have appeared in the even before the , with a pink Butterfree being one of the first to appear in Bye Bye Butterfree. Many alternately colored Pokémon appear in the Orange Islands saga due to the setting's tropical climate. Many of these Pokémon have different color palettes than the palette for Shiny Pokémon of that species that were introduced in . After the games' release, Pokémon with the regular Shiny palette began to make appearances starting with .
